# Unshaken Faith
## Scripture
"He kept me safe from the battle line and rescued me from my enemies." – 1 Samuel 22:23
## Reflection
As warriors of Christ, we are called to live a life of unshaken faith, even in the midst of chaos and uncertainty. David, a man after God's own heart, faced countless battles and enemies, yet he remained steadfast in his trust in God. He knew that God was his shield and his deliverer. In the same way, we can find peace and courage in the midst of adversity by trusting in God's sovereignty and goodness. We don't have to be shaken by the trials of life because we know that God is always with us, guiding and protecting us.

## Daily Challenge
"Do 25 jumping jacks while declaring that you trust in God's goodness."
